writeups.body:
# Example: size follows the stop

This is an example write-up, not real research.

## What we asked

- Does a wide stop deserve fewer contracts?

## What we found

| Stop | Micros | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Wide | 4 | +$310 |
| Tight | 8 | +$290 |

The wide stop lost less when wrong. Same profit, smaller dips.

writeups.title: Example: trade only the London morning
writeups.summary: Example study. Taking only entries before 08:00 ET made about $1,800 a month in the example, with fewer trades but a better win rate. Needs a longer test before any change.

writeups.title: Example: skip every Friday
writeups.summary: Example study. Skipping Fridays lost about -$640 a month in the example and cut the trades below two a week. Do not redo without a new idea.

writeups.title: Example: pause during big news
writeups.summary: Example study. Pausing around news changed the result by only -$30 a month in the example. The bot already stays out of trouble.

writeups.title: Example: add a second entry
writeups.summary: Example study. A scale-in added about $950 a month in the example but doubles the risk on a bad day, so it waits for a paper roundtrip.

writeups.title: Example: how much slippage the bots survive
writeups.summary: Example reference. Each extra tick of slippage changes the result by -$15 a month in the example; the plan stays positive up to eight ticks.

writeups.title: Example: a fixed 2R target instead of the VIX band
writeups.summary: Example study. A fixed 2R target made -$1,200 a month less than the VIX-band target in the example. Keep the band.

writeups.title: Example: a second slot for the Asia session
writeups.summary: Example finding. Asia trades were rare and small, about $120 a month in the example. Fun to watch, not worth the clutter.

writeups.title: Example: pass the eval in two weeks
writeups.summary: Example study. A bigger first-week size passed the example eval inside two weeks 58% of the time instead of 54%, worth about $400 a month in saved fees and time.

writeups.title: Example: sit out after two losses in a row
writeups.summary: Example study. Sitting out after two losses cost about -$310 a month in the example because the next trade was often the winner.
